summary: Spiderling Studios' medieval physics sandbox about building siege engines and strange vehicles to solve destruction puzzles, with a broad PC, console, Switch, and mobile platform spread.

entries.title: Besiege
entries.definitive_edition: Windows PC release with owned DLC

emulation.notes: Run natively on Windows with workshop/editor access.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Windows PC release with full creation tools

primary.why: Besiege released for Windows, macOS, and Linux in 2020 after Early Access, later coming to Xbox, PlayStation, Switch, iOS, and Android. The PC version is the most complete because it has multiplayer and level-editor functionality that console versions lack.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows PC version with workshop/editor/multiplayer support and owned DLC; use console/Switch/mobile versions only as access alternatives.

entries.remaster_caveats: Console/mobile versions are access alternatives, not feature-complete replacements for the PC creation ecosystem.
